description: The OCCURS clause in a report group description entry (§2023:13.18.38 format 3 — OCCURS [integer-1 TO] integer-2 TIMES [DEPENDING ON data-name-1] [STEP integer-3]): a REPEATING ENTRY, which §2023:13.18.38.4 GR10 makes "define integer-2 distinct report items", GR11 gives every repetition the same PICTURE/VALUE/JUSTIFIED/BLANK WHEN ZERO/GROUP INDICATE effect, GR12 spaces by the STEP phrase and GR13 counts by the DEPENDING operand. LIVE ON BOTH AXES (kb/Work PB565): the binder REPLAYS the entry's subtree once per repetition, so §2023:13.18.63.4 GR21's import of GR9 (a VALUE reaches every occurrence) and GR22's OCCURS-DEPENDING suppressor both ride it. The entry's AXIS is fixed by the clause it carries — a LINE clause on the entry or in its subtree repeats it VERTICALLY (GR10c/GR10d, GR12c/GR12d), anything else horizontally (GR10a/GR10b, GR12a/GR12b) — and integer-3 displaces on that axis only. The COBOL-85 report group description entry had no OCCURS clause at all.
display: OCCURS (report group description — a repeating entry)
vcr: 2002 RW addition (the 85 report group description entry has no OCCURS clause; the repeating-entry family — multiple LINE/COLUMN, VARYING, PRESENT WHEN — all enter at 2002)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRMO1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT RPT ASSIGN TO "vmrmo1.rpt".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD RPT REPORT IS R-1.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R-1 PAGE LIMIT IS 20 LINES.
01 D-1 TYPE DE.
   03 LINE PLUS 1.
      05 COLUMN 1 PIC X(2) OCCURS 3 TIMES STEP 3 VALUE "OK".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT RPT.
    INITIATE R-1.
    GENERATE D-1.
    TERMINATE R-1.
    CLOSE RPT.
    STOP RUN.
